subject: Scarborough Labs - ephemeral VPC pilot & audit access / exec approval needed
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@scarboroughlabs.com>
Cc: Eve Carter <eve.carter@scarboroughlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed private VPC pilot + ephemeral host request

Tom —

Great to meet last week. Attached is an updated SOW for the Private VPC pilot we discussed (Scarborough_SOW_v3.pdf). Two items came up in procurement that I want to flag early so we can align before they become blockers:

1) Ephemeral hosting: Scarborough asked that certain inference workers run in ephemeral, short-lived hosts inside your VPC to satisfy isolated processing for PII workflows.
2) Audit access: procurement asked for a 48-hour forensic access window per quarter where they can run snapshots and forensics and retrieve logs.

From our side we can support a timeboxed audit window and provide secure, logged jumpbox access, but there are operational constraints (no standing access, platform KMS controls, limited egress). Also: we typically price Private pilots with an onboarding fee plus committed term discounts for concessions like this.

Can you confirm the required retention window and whether the audit should include raw VM snapshots or just application logs and telemetry? That affects the legal redlines and pricing that I’ll need to route to Deal Desk.

Next steps: if you confirm, I’ll loop in Deal Desk and legal for an exception/exec approval.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@scarboroughlabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@scarboroughlabs.com>, Eve Carter <eve.carter@scarboroughlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed private VPC pilot + ephemeral host request

Naomi —

Thanks for the SOW and summary. A few clarifications from procurement:

- Audit: we need ability to run a snapshot and pull logs for a max 48-hour window, up to 2x per year, for compliance with our auditors. The snapshot would be limited to the ephemeral worker instances and our own data only.
- Data residency: all inference output and logs for the pilot must remain in us-west-2.
- Pricing: given this is strategic for us, we’re asking for a concession: 15% off list for the first 12 months and waiving the onboarding fee if we commit to a 12-month pilot.

Procurement is standing by for your legal/ops constraints. If you can get a quick exec approval for the access pattern and discount, we’ll route the contract immediately.

Tom
VP Product, Scarborough Labs
tom.rivera@scarboroughlabs.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jordan.blake@redwood.com <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: eve.carter@scarboroughlabs.com <eve.carter@scarboroughlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Scarborough Labs - ephemeral host request — need deal desk + legal review / exec signoff

Team —

Forwarding Scarborough’s asks. TL;DR: 48-hour snapshot window (2x/yr), ephemeral workers inside customer VPC, strict us-west-2 residency, customer asking for 15% discount + waive onboarding fee for 12-month commitment.

Can Deal Desk and Legal advise what we can approve at junior levels and what needs Markus’ signoff? Operational notes: we can restrict snapshots to application layer logs and provide a temporary jumpbox for forensic runs, but raw VM snapshots are a higher risk (preserves host-level secrets).

Attachments: Security_Questionnaire_Answers.xlsx — they already answered many questions.

Appreciate fast turnaround — procurement is ready to sign if we can meet the asks.

—Naomi

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jordan.blake@redwood.com <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: eve.carter@scarboroughlabs.com <eve.carter@scarboroughlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scarborough Labs - ephemeral host request — legal comments

Naomi / team —

Legal review (high level):
- Raw VM snapshots: we cannot provide ongoing ability for customers to take raw host-level snapshots that could capture platform secrets or other tenants. If Scarborough insists on snapshots, they must be limited to customer namespaces and require a signed one-time attestation and an escorted run by our security engineer. Recommend we offer: application-level snapshots (app logs, audit trail, per-request traces) plus a timeboxed forensic snapshot only under a written request and with our engineer present.
- Audit window: limiting to two 48-hour windows per 12 months is acceptable, but we need to cap forensic actions (no host-level memory dumps, no persistence of extracted images on their side).
- Data residency/us-west-2: acceptable with standard DPA addendum. We will require proof of the customer’s KMS acceptance for any exported logs.
- Pricing: our standard concession for similar asks has been a waived onboarding fee + a mid-single-digit percent discount, or a larger discount in exchange for a longer commitment + irrevocable upfront credit. 15% is above precedent for pilot commitments.

Requested redlines attached (Legal_Redline_Summary.pdf). If sales wants a one-time executive exception (waive onboarding + 12–15% discount), need approval from Markus with the following conditions: 12-month committed term, SOC2 Type II evidence within 90 days, two audit windows max per year, security escort for any forensic host inspections, and a one-time non-refundable onboarding credit to cover ops costs.

-Rishi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jordan.blake@redwood.com <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, eve.carter@scarboroughlabs.com <eve.carter@scarboroughlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — Scarborough Labs concession (ephemeral hosts + audit windows)

Markus —

Scarborough is a strategic target in Q4. They’ve asked for:
- Ephemeral inference workers inside their VPC (us-west-2)
- 2x/year, 48-hour forensic/audit windows with snapshot capability limited to their data
- 15% discount for 12 months and onboarding fee waived if we accept

Legal recommends a more conservative stance (see redline) and outlined the conditions that would make an exception safe: 12-month committed term, SOC2 Type II evidence in 90 days, two audit windows max/yr, forensic runs escorted and limited to app-level snapshots, and a one-time onboarding credit.

From a sales standpoint, we can likely close if we grant the waived onboarding fee and a discount in the low double digits. My ask: permission to offer a one-time exception up to 12% discount with the legal conditions above. If you approve up to 12%, Rishi will prepare the redlines and I’ll finalize the DocuSign route. If you want to push to 15% I’ll escalate further but would need an explicit greenlight.

Proposed quick terms for approval:
- 12-month term
- Waive onboarding fee (one-time non-refundable operational credit of $12,500 in lieu of a full fee)
- Discount: up to 12% first 12 months
- Audit windows: 2x/year, 48 hours each, escorted, app-level snapshots only
- SOC2 evidence within 90 days or reversion to list pricing

Thanks for a quick read. Procurement is expecting a decision by EOD Thursday PT.

—Naomi

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: Eve Carter <eve.carter@scarboroughlabs.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@scarboroughlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Scarborough Labs concession (ephemeral hosts + audit windows)

Team / Scarborough —

I reviewed the request and legal’s redlines. I approve a one-time exception with the following binding conditions:

1) Commercial: 12-month committed term; 12% discount applied to first 12 months; waive onboarding fee in favor of a one-time non-refundable operational credit of $12,500 (recorded as credit on the invoice).
2) Security & ops: Ephemeral workers permitted inside customer VPC limited to us-west-2. Audit windows capped at two (2) per 12-month period, each window not to exceed 48 consecutive hours. Forensic snapshots may be taken only of application-level artifacts and logs; no raw hypervisor/host memory or disk images will be provided. Any forensic collection must be scheduled, documented, and performed with a Redwood security engineer present.
3) Compliance: Scarborough must provide SOC2 Type II evidence (or equivalent) within 90 days of contract execution. If evidence is not received within 90 days, Redwood reserves the right to suspend the discounted pricing and require remedial controls or terminate pilot access.
4) Data residency & egress: All customer data and logs for the pilot must remain in us-west-2. Any export of log extracts requires customer KMS keys approved by Redwood and explicit write-once audit of extracted artifacts.
5) Legal: Amend DPA per Legal_Redline_Summary.pdf and add a clause limiting use of forensic artifacts and forbidding persistence of platform-level secrets.

If Scarborough agrees, Legal will produce a DocuSign packet with the redlines and the commercial terms. Naomi — you have my signoff to proceed and finalize. Please ensure sales ops codes the credit and that Finance is looped for billing treatment.

-Markus
VP Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
